content_of_post_to_answer: Do you delete photos that you don't like immediately?
answer: Not immediately. Sometimes a photo looks bad because of poor lighting or an awkward expression; sometimes I dislike it because I don't like how I look that day. Those are two very different reasons. I delete the obvious mistakes, but I hesitate over the rest. A photo is a record of a moment, not a verdict on my appearance. The picture I dislike today might be the only ordinary memory I have of a day I'll miss years from now.
